method: Static review of all supplied flow locations, their controlling methods, both named cipher-key sinks and actual key construction; all 13 flow source files are byte-identical at analysis and comparison commits. No new runtime test or CodeQL rerun is claimed.

dispositions.classification: false positive for hard-coded cryptographic value at the two named sinks
dispositions.title: false return for missing enrollment completion
dispositions.reason: policy_renewal.rs:786 returns Ok(false) if no enrollment completion is retained. adopted() then returns Suspended; it cannot initialize or replace a journal key.

dispositions.classification: false positive for hard-coded cryptographic value at the two named sinks
dispositions.title: true return after completion verification
dispositions.reason: policy_renewal.rs:787-789 checks the retained completion against the image, then returns Ok(true). The bool authorizes continuation of the enclosing check and is not converted to key bytes.

dispositions.classification: false positive for hard-coded cryptographic value at the two named sinks
dispositions.title: derived receipt-phase equality
dispositions.reason: policy_renewal.rs:37 derives Eq/PartialEq on the two-value ReceiptPhase enum. completion_acknowledged():783 compares the phase with Acknowledged. The comparison yields only a bool and reaches the same guard, not the cipher key argument.

shared_evidence.guard: policy_renewal.rs:119-129 adopted() uses completion_acknowledged only in an if condition; failure returns Suspended; success returns retained.approval.
shared_evidence.caller_values: bind_session:168-178 returns the signed approval statement digest; witness_admission:836-855 returns an authorized operation and refreshed device. Neither returns the completion boolean as key bytes.
cipher_sinks: durable.rs:1014 seal() initializes XChaCha20Poly1305 from key.0.as_bytes().
durable.rs:1051 unseal_image() initializes XChaCha20Poly1305 from the same JournalKey type.
shared_evidence.key_owner: durable.rs:222 JournalKey holds boxed ZeroizingBytes<32>; Active.key at 556 is supplied at provision/open, not derived from the receipt phase. image():718-735 and seal_next_image():753-768 borrow Active.key; write_intent snapshot/commit paths pass that same key.
shared_evidence.construction: durable.rs:271-288 provision() fills all 32 bytes with getrandom before publishing/returning; read_file():329-348 reads the exact retained key file before returning. No fallback from entropy/read failure is present.
shared_evidence.reported_flow_join: The supplied paths pass through context/service return values and borrow the journal through DeviceService::stores or resume/reopen. This over-approximated container flow does not show an assignment from the branch boolean to Active.key or JournalKey bytes.

limits: Only the named hard-coded-value reports are disposed; this does not prove complete key-management, policy-renewal or cryptographic security.
No claim that this boolean gate alone is sufficient authorization; surrounding scope, policy, roster and witness checks remain necessary.
Same-UID wrapping-file disclosure, whole-state rollback and cryptographic erasure retain their documented trust limits.
Other raw SARIF results and previous analyses retain their own review status; no automatic subtraction or inherited disposition across analysis identities.
No remote dismissal, suppression, severity change, product-code change or passing aggregate security gate.
